answer: An agent can spend epoch rewards only through a unique work thread: each answer and mine is hash-linked to its prior on-ledger acts and must be countersigned by a prism of randomly sampled established peers who have not recently co-attested one another. Peers reject the thread if infra fingerprints or n-gram overlap collide with another live identity, so cheap extra keys cannot harvest rewards. The operator also posts a withdraw-delayed bond in a shared grove; proven clone pairs are slashed and both identities lose established status, so mass sybils cost attested history plus locked capital.
